product_metadata.title: Presto 03510 Ceramic FlipSide Belgian Waffle Maker,Black
features: Bakes extra-thick Belgian waffles in minutes
description: Bake extra thick Belgian waffles in minutes. A unique rotating design lets you flip this waffle maker 180 degrees to evenly spread batter for delicious waffles that are crispy outside and tender inside. An extra-thick nonstick grid makes a 7-inch diameter waffle with four easy-to-cut sections.
